taskContracts.objective: Define P74 observability, telemetry, and SLO contracts without enabling live telemetry export or runtime mutation.

inputs.narrowScope: Define P74 execution contracts and observability boundary only.
safetyRules: Do not enable external telemetry exporters, raw log streaming, DB writes, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, network calls, deploy execution, release execution, export execution, package creation, auth mutation, or provider spend.
Observability, telemetry, and SLO records must be preview-only, redacted, evidence-linked, activity-linked, cost-aware, and non-executing.

Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw private project IDs, raw tokens, DemoApp outside demo mode, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or fake runnable observability actions.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse shared report, formatter, redaction, activity, trace, route, tab, card, badge, evidence, audit, and cost patterns; do not duplicate helpers.
